candidates.summary: no fixture frees more of the sponsor's storage than it locked in the tx, so the split refund (sponsor share plus a caller remainder sent with released=0) and gnokey's partial SponsorRefund subtraction at root.go:127-133 are unpinned
candidates.failure_scenario: Sponsor locks X in msg1, a later message frees bytes worth Y > X in the sponsor's storage: sponsorShare=X goes back with the byte release, Y-X goes to the caller with released 0. Passing released to both calls (the double-decrement the comment at keeper.go:2553-2555 warns of), or dropping the remainder refund, leaves every test green; the only sponsor_refund fixture (paystorage_sponsor_grow_free_no_drain, locked 288500, freed 287500) has FeeRefund == SponsorRefund, so the remainder branch never runs and keyscli's refund.Amount > 0 path after subtraction is never hit with a positive remainder

(only gnovm/cmd/calibrate/native_machine_bench_test.go hits); grep -ln sponsor_refund gno.land/pkg/integration/testdata/*.txtar (only paystorage_sponsor_grow_free_no_drain, 288500 locked vs 287500 freed); then mutate keeper.go:2564 to pass `released` instead of 0, or delete lines 2562-2567, and run go test ./gno.land/pkg/integration/ -run 'TestTestdata/pay(gas|storage)_' : expect a red, observe none
